alignNoPackage: No package for this screen on the server.
allAligned: All screens run the server version.
clientsText: Screens are updated through this server, without internet on the screens. Only one screen per zone updates at a time. A screen has {minutes} minutes to come back with the new version; a failure stops the update of the remaining screens.
currentHint: Packages of the running version are used to bring screens to the server version.
dailyCheck: Check for new releases once a day (only a hint, nothing is installed automatically)
deleteFilesConfirm: Delete the downloaded files of version {version}? You can download or upload them again later.
installNotPossible: This server cannot update itself (see status). Use the installer of the release instead.
installStepBackup: The database and the configuration are backed up first.
installStepClients: Afterwards the screens are updated one by one, never more than one per zone at a time.
installStepRestart: The server restarts with the new version (a few seconds without the web interface; screens keep playing).
installStepRollback: If the new version fails its self-test, the previous version and the backed-up data are restored automatically.
installText: The server is updated from {from} to {to}:
keyRemoveConfirm: Remove this key? Releases signed only with it are no longer accepted.
keysText: Releases are only accepted when their signature matches one of these keys. Built-in keys come with this version. Screens check every release themselves with their built-in keys and the keys of their installation (installer option --trusted-key); a key added here does not count for screens.
noClientPackages: The packages of version {version} are missing on this server. Download that release or upload its file.
noReleases: No release known yet. Check for updates or upload a release file.
noServerPackage: This release has no package for this server ({platform}).
offlineText: Without internet: upload the file opensignage-<version>-bundle.tar of a release. It is checked like a download (signature and checksums).
olderHidden: {count} older releases without files on this server are hidden.
repoHint: Leave empty to use the default of this build: {repo}
restartingText: The server restarts and checks itself. This page reloads automatically. If the new version does not start properly, the previous version and its data are restored automatically.
rolledBackText: The new version did not pass its self-test. The previous version and the data from before the update are active again. Details are in the history below.
rolledBackTitle: The update to {version} was rolled back
rolloutStartConfirm: Bring all screens with another version to version {version}? Screens are updated one by one per zone.
serverReason.not_installed: This server was not installed with the OpenSignage installer (or its release folders were changed). Update it with the installer.
serverReason.not_linux: Server updates from the web interface work on Linux installations made with the installer.
serverReason.not_writable: The server cannot write to its release folder. Run the installer again to repair the permissions.
title: Updates
